review_type: same-team source and retained-record audits; authorship overlap disclosed

fallacy_scan.Simpson paradox: Not an aggregate efficacy comparison; per-parameter groups and global gradient norms remain separate.
fallacy_scan.Ecological fallacy: Coordinate failures are not treated as request-level or algorithm-level failure rates.
fallacy_scan.Berkson paradox: Fixed first-two-anchor fixture; no outcome-based case selection or population association claim.
fallacy_scan.Collider bias: No conditioning-on-outcome inference; exact support checks are correctness gates.
fallacy_scan.Base rate neglect: All coordinate and tensor denominators reported; nonzero-coordinate denominator is unavailable.
fallacy_scan.Regression to mean: No retry or retuning after an extreme discrepancy; no pre/post improvement claim.
fallacy_scan.Survivorship bias: Failed case and all unattempted cases retained; no selective exclusion.
fallacy_scan.Look-elsewhere effect: Fixed numerical gates applied without post-result threshold selection; parameter distribution is descriptive.
fallacy_scan.Garden of forking paths: No tolerance, algorithm, sample or runtime modification after observing the failure.
fallacy_scan.Correlation versus causation: BF16/head/backward causes remain hypotheses; proposed isolation not executed.
fallacy_scan.Reverse causality: No directional causal association is inferred from the discrepancy or one rejected candidate.
